The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 195-196. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Assume the parameter range of Theorem 8.8. In the setup of Proposition A.3, suppose the two clear sides contain at least n physical time steps. Require the external tensors to come from fixed finite physical-layer networks of Theorem 8.8. Fix the mesh, the routing, and all inserted data before taking the even circumference-to-infinity limit. Normalize each physical row by its own vacuum divisor as in (8.43). The resulting plane vacuum coefficient is bounded by Cn−1+ρ ∥Ψ−∥∥Ψ+∥ or Cn−1−ρ ∥Ψ−∥∥Ψ+∥, (A.10) 195 for the low or high stencil, respectively. Here ∥Ψ±∥2 denotes the corresponding nonnegative reflected plane vacuum ratio, which is finite, with its matching cut kernel from Theorem 8.8. The constant may depend on the fixed routing geometry. Ordinary tile-axis folds satisfy the corresponding plane Cauchy–Schwarz inequality.
